subject: POC: hands-on kickoff + split sync/async plan (prompt review, routing, light load)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@brightapps.io>, Carlos Rivera <carlos@brightapps.io>, BrightApps POC Ops <poc-ops@brightapps.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC: hands-on kickoff + split sync/async plan (prompt review, routing, light load)

Hi Sofia / Carlos —

Thanks again for moving forward with the Redwood POC. To make the first session productive for both teams, we suggest a two-part approach: a 60-minute live kickoff focused on prompt review, routing setup, and verifying integration, followed (optionally) by a short light load validation that we can either do live or run asynchronously depending on your ops availability.

Proposed live kickoff slots (all in EST):
- Tue Jan 12 — 10:00–11:00 EST
- Tue Jan 12 — 16:00–17:00 EST
- Wed Jan 13 — 09:00–10:00 EST

Agenda (attached: POC-Agenda.pdf):
- 5m introductions & success criteria
- 20m prompt review & expected outputs (bring a handful of example prompts)
- 15m routing & model variant discussion (latency vs cost knobs)
- 15m integration checks + plan for a 10–15m light load run (if you want live validation)

If you prefer not to do the load run in the initial meeting, we can run it asynchronously the following day and share results/trace logs. Please confirm the slot that works and who from your side will join (engineering, security, data platform?). Also let us know if we should lock a separate load test slot — we can propose windows after the live session.

Attachments: POC-Agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 17:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: hands-on kickoff + split sync/async plan (internal)

Laura — quick internal note: BrightApps mentioned in discovery they have engineers on the east coast and a security lead in Amsterdam. If Sofia replies asking for CET-friendly times we should offer either Jan 13 morning EST (which is afternoon CET) or Jan 14 early EST. Also propose we suggest an asynchronous load window (UTC-friendly) so their EU folks don't have to stay late.

For the live session, I'll prepare a short checklist for prompt examples and a condensed routing demo (3 prompts / 2 model variants). Monica — can you drop the draft eval prompt set into the shared folder?

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@brightapps.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos@brightapps.io>, BrightApps POC Ops <poc-ops@brightapps.io>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC: hands-on kickoff + split sync/async plan (BrightApps)

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the options. Apologies — we just got a calendar conflict on Jan 12 morning that affects two of our engineers. Would it be possible to move the live kickoff to Tue Jan 12 at 11:00 EST or Wed Jan 13 at 09:00 EST? If neither works we can do Jan 12 at 16:00 EST but would prefer earlier if possible.

Also, heads-up: we'll include our security lead (Elena Kuznetsova) and our data platform engineer (Carlos Rivera) on the call. For the load validation, we prefer to run that asynchronously and receive the logs — tight change windows on our side this week. I'll attach our internal checklist for POC readiness.

Attached: BrightApps-POC-Checklist.docx

Best,
Sofia Martinez
Program Manager — BrightApps Inc.
sofia@brightapps.io | +1 646 555 0199

Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: hands-on kickoff + split sync/async plan (confirming Jan 12 / async load)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick note. We can do Tue Jan 12 at 11:00 EST to accommodate your team. I've penciled it in on our side and created a calendar invite (redwood-poc-kickoff.ics).

Plan for the session: we'll keep the live meeting focused to the 60-minute window (prompt examples, routing demo, integration smoke tests). Per your preference, Redwood will run the light load validation asynchronously on Wed Jan 13 in a UTC window and share detailed traces + a short summary. If the async results look questionable we can schedule a focused follow-up load window with your ops team.

Action items for BrightApps before the meeting:
- Confirm attendees (please include names & titles)
- Upload 6–8 sample prompts to the shared Drive link (we'll use these for the prompt review and routing checks)
- Confirm whether you want us to bring token-cost estimates for each model variant during the meeting (we can keep it high-level)

I attached the calendar invite and re-attached the POC agenda. Let me know if anything else is needed.

Attachments: redwood-poc-kickoff.ics, POC-Agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
